messages:
kevin: hey team! first day here. monitor arrived but has a small cluster of bright pixels top-right and there was no USB-Ethernet dongle in the box. anyone know the process for swaps? also my VPN config failed when i tried to connect just now.
rachel_it: welcome Kevin :wave: sorry about that. can you share the monitor serial and a quick photo of the pixel cluster? i can escalate to shipping for an RMA. which laptop model did you get?
kevin: Monitor serial VSN-7782123, attaching photo in thread (img uploaded). laptop is MacBook Pro 14" M2.
shipping-bot: package PKG-9001 delivered to 3rd floor seat 8 at 08:45. items: MacBook Pro, ViewLux 27, USB-C dock. missing: USB-Ethernet adapter.
sophie: hi Kevin, welcome to infra team! for VPN, what error are you seeing? common one is missing device cert or MFA.
kevin: vpn error: "Certificate validation failed" and then it drops. i ran the quickstart script from the onboarding doc.
rachel_it: looks like your device cert hasn't been pushed by MDM yet. i triggered a re-sync for your device (email registered to kevin@redwood.com). it-bot: MDM re-enrollment queued for kevin@redwood.com (device id D-3344). expected completion 15m.
kevin: thanks. photo of monitor: small bright dot cluster near top-right edge, visible on white background. not huge but noticeable on docs.
rachel_it: can you try a simple test: open a pure white image in Preview and move the window around. if dead pixels are stuck bright, we should RMA. i'll open the ticket.
kevin: did that, pixels remain lit.
shipping-bot: spare USB-Ethernet adapter dispatched from IT locker -> ETA 30m.
sophie: MDM re-enroll finished and device cert installed. try the VPN again and paste the client logs if it fails.
kevin: re-tried VPN -> got stuck on MFA prompt, but after approving MFA it connected fine. maybe cert install required a restart though i didn't reboot.
sophie: sometimes the VPN client caches old state. if it connects now, it's good. i'll monitor auth logs for any hiccups.
kevin: great, VPN stable now. thanks!
rachel_it: ticket IT-7009 created for monitor RMA and missing dongle follow-up. i'll mark monitor as RMA requested and note urgency: new hire.
it-bot: ticket IT-7009 created and assigned to rachel_it. ETA RMA pickup 2 business days.
kevin: shipping-bot says dongle arriving soon so i'll be fine for now. appreciate the quick help.
rachel_it: excellent. once the RMA is approved we'll get a replacement unit shipped. if you want a temporary external webcam or stand while that processes let us know.
kevin: all good for now. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
